    from rcb_client import Robot

    spec = r.spec()                               # action types + dims + limits, cameras, budgets
    obs = r.get_obs()                             # current frames: obs.last["head_camera"] -> uint8 HxWx3, obs.meta["proprio"]
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.05)    # actions: (T, 14); returns the execution video
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions)                    # (T, 16); planner per row (see spec)
    res.video["head_camera"]  -> mp4 bytes     res.frames["head_camera"] -> uint8 (N,H,W,3) if video="frames"/"both"
    res.last["left_camera"]   -> uint8 HxWx3   res.proprio -> float32 (N, 30)   res.meta -> dict (done, plan, clipped, ...)

+"""Camera-guided controller for the handle-press-side episode.
+
+This script deliberately uses only the robot client observations (RGB/depth,

+the service episode is persistent and this script never resets it.

+

+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/handle_press_side")
+CAMERAS = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]
+DT = 0.0125
+
+
+def current(obs):
+    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    p = dict(zip(layout, now))
+    return p
+
+
+def move_mocap(robot, dest, name, step_m=0.004, settle_steps=60):
+    """Move the hand target at a measured, bounded rate, then let it settle."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    p = current(obs)
+    start = np.array([p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], p["mocap_z"]])
+    dest = np.asarray(dest, dtype=float)
+    delta = dest - start
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / step_m)))
+    xyz = np.tile(delta / (0.01 * n), (n, 1))
+    actions = np.zeros((n + settle_steps, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+    actions[:n, :3] = xyz
+    actions[:, 3] = -1.0  # keep fingers open while moving and pressing
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
+        cameras=CAMERAS, video_fps=10, video="frames", include_depth=True,
+        note=name,
+    )
+    folder = OUT / name
+    res.save(str(folder))
+    final = current(type("Obs", (), {"meta": {"proprio": {
+        "layout": robot.spec()["proprio_layout"], "now": res.proprio[-1].tolist()
+    }}})()) if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio) else None
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "name": name,
+        "start_mocap": start.tolist(),
+        "dest_mocap": dest.tolist(),
+        "rows": len(actions),
+        "control_steps": res.meta.get("control_steps"),
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "final_proprio": final,
+        "saved": str(folder),
+    }, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+def approach():
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    p = current(obs)
+    target = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
+    print("target", target.tolist(), "current", [p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]])
+
+    # Lift above the fixture, then approach the handle from the open side.
+    move_mocap(robot, [p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], 0.32], "01_lift")
+    move_mocap(robot, [target[0] - 0.04, target[1], 0.32], "02_hover_over_handle")
+
+
+def main():
